summary: Firefox is shifting font parsing and measurement toward Skrifa, a modern Rust font engine, across FreeType, DirectWrite, Core Text, downloaded webfonts, glyph lookup, metrics, and font-table access. This improves consistency and robustness for installed and web fonts, adds CSS support for Fangsong and Kai families, and makes font caches and character maps safer to share. The graphics sanity checks were also extended to cover hardware video encoding, with improved handling of Linux systems that lack DMA-BUF support.
